[G] DiagramService
|
|-- create(input) -> DiagramRevisionResult
|-- getRevision(revisionId) -> DiagramRevision
|-- listRevisions(diagramId) -> revision summaries
|-- revise(baseRevisionId, edit)
|   |-- DiagramRevisionEditor prepares content changes
|   `-- issue immutable revision; preserve proven node correspondence
`-- generate(request, options)
    |-- configured DiagramGenerator produces content and evidence
    `-- create or revise -> DiagramRevisionResult

RevisionedDiagramService is the sole content writer.
Canvas contexts and history belong to CanvasHistoryService -> [E].
Storage persist/restore belongs to DiagramPersistence -> PersistentLayer.
Source: domain/core/diagrams/diagramService.ts
